events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, concluded on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the legendary Woodstock Festival wrapped up, leaving an indelible mark on music and culture. What's your favourite memory or track from that era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, the world lost a legend. Remembering Elvis Presley, whose music continues to define generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, we lost one of the greatest guitarists of all time. Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix and his incredible legacy.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the zebra crossing to those unforgettable tracks, what's your favourite moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders continues to rock. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, still bringing the rock and roll. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon released the powerful anthem 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the original, changing how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you fit on yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond movie moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire millions. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles released their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A truly diverse collection of tracks. What's your favourite song from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago, the world lost an icon. Remembering the magnificent Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
